subject.title: fix: honor configured provider timeouts after plugin model rebuilds

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical repair for configured provider timeouts after plugin model or transport rebuilds, including the intentional opt-in extension of affected stream watchdog lifetimes?
rationale: The code changes runtime availability for existing operator-selected timeout settings. The PR presents evidence that run and agent ceilings still bound it, but accepting that compatibility behavior is an explicit maintainer merge decision.

options.title: Accept the documented timeout behavior
options.body: Merge after required checks pass, treating the configured provider timeout as the intended watchdog ceiling even after a plugin rebuilds the model.

options.title: Request a narrower compatibility proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a maintainer requests and receives exact-head upgrade evidence for an affected external rebuilding provider plugin.

recommendation.title: Accept the documented timeout behavior
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks pass, treating the configured provider timeout as the intended watchdog ceiling even after a plugin rebuilds the model.

likelyOwner.reason: The current canonical implementation and supporting timeout-precedence evidence are authored on this branch by steipete.
